faqSection.lead: The most important questions about courses, booking and how it works — answered briefly.
faqSection.title: Answers at a glance.

faqs.a: Choose a course in the course finder or on the “Dates & Booking” page, check the date and location, and send your booking enquiry using the form. Our team will then confirm your enquiry. All dates on this website are demo dates.
faqs.q: How do I book a course with VITASALVA?

faqs.a: Yes. For companies we offer in-house training — our trainers come to your premises. You can find details and the process on the “For Companies” page or via the contact form.
faqs.q: Do courses also take place directly at our company?

faqs.a: Yes, after successfully completing the course, participants receive a certificate of attendance. You can find out which certificates apply to individual courses on the relevant course page.
faqs.q: Will I receive a certificate after the course?

faqs.a: We deliberately work with small learning groups so that every participant gets enough practice time and questions can be answered directly.
faqs.q: How large are the learning groups?

faqs.a: Our courses are held in German. Course materials and training documents are also in German.
faqs.q: What language are the courses held in?

faqs.a: Cancellation and rebooking are usually possible. We will share the exact conditions with you when we confirm your booking — just talk to us.
faqs.q: Can I cancel or rebook a course?

When you use our contact or booking forms, we collect the data you provide (e.g. name, email address, message) in order to process your enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR.

When you visit this website, the hosting provider stores technical access data (e.g. IP address, date and time, pages visited) in server log files. This data is used for technical security and is not combined with other data sources.

You have the right to access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16 GDPR), erasure (Art. 17 GDPR), restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR), data portability (Art. 20 GDPR) and to object to processing (Art. 21 GDPR). You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
Personal data is only stored for as long as necessary to process your enquiry or as required by statutory retention obligations.
This website embeds fonts from Google Fonts. Your IP address may be transmitted to Google in the process. Further information can be found in Google's privacy policy.
If you have any questions about data protection, please contact [Email address] or write to the address above.

ueberUns.storyLead: Safety can be learned — when knowledge is taught practically, clearly and at the highest level. That is exactly what VITASALVA stands for.
ueberUns.storyText1: We develop training for people who carry responsibility: in companies, in institutions, on construction sites and in everyday life. Our ambition is a learning experience that sticks — and truly helps in an emergency.
ueberUns.storyText2: We focus on small groups, experienced trainers and content based on real situations. No overcrowded halls, no pure lectures — just practice, exchange and real competence.
ueberUns.storyTitle: Knowledge that counts in an emergency.
ueberUns.title: A brand that stands for safety.

cpr-aed.title: CPR & Automated External Defibrillator (AED)
cpr-aed.description: Chest compressions, rescue breaths and AED use — the core skills that restart a heart.
cpr-aed.outcome: Perform high-quality CPR and use an AED confidently on adults.

workplace-first-aid.title: Workplace Emergency First Aid (EFAW)
workplace-first-aid.description: The essential first aid course for appointed first aiders and safety officers.
workplace-first-aid.outcome: Assess an incident and give effective first aid until help arrives.

pediatric-life-support.title: Pediatric & Infant Life Support
pediatric-life-support.description: Age-specific resuscitation and emergency care for babies and children.
pediatric-life-support.outcome: Respond correctly to emergencies involving infants and children.
highlights: Accident prevention at school and home

bleeding-trauma.title: Severe Bleeding & Trauma Control
bleeding-trauma.description: Stop life-threatening bleeding fast with pressure, dressings and tourniquets.
bleeding-trauma.outcome: Control severe bleeding and stabilise trauma casualties.

burns-fractures.title: Burns, Fractures & Chemical Injuries
burns-fractures.description: Immediate care for burns, broken bones and chemical exposure.
burns-fractures.outcome: Treat burns, immobilise fractures and respond to chemical injuries.

choking-airway.title: Choking & Airway Management
choking-airway.description: Clear blocked airways and keep the casualty breathing.
choking-airway.outcome: Recognise choking and clear an obstructed airway quickly.

industrial-rescue.title: Industrial & Construction Site Rescue
industrial-rescue.description: Emergency response for high-risk sites: falls, crush injuries and confined spaces.
industrial-rescue.outcome: Lead a safe first response at an industrial or construction incident.
industrial-rescue.audience: Site managers, construction and industry crews
highlights: Rescue from heights and confined spaces

mental-health.title: Mental Health First Aid & Crisis Response
mental-health.description: Recognise distress, start a supportive conversation and guide someone to help.
mental-health.outcome: Support a colleague in crisis and know where to refer them.
